review_candidates.title: Desktop Support Technician
review_candidates.description: Summary This is a professional, desktop support role responsible for maintaining, repair, and upgrade computer equipment including, but not limited to: workstations, printers, operating systems and software. The individual will provide technical software, hardware, and basic network problem resolution to end users by performing appropriate diagnostics and guiding users through step-by-step solutions on both a hands-on and call-back basis. Essential Functions Essential Duties Diagnoses and resolves problems with PCs, local printers, end-user connectivity, software and configuration, email, as well as other hardware and network issues. Ensures timely resolution/referral of user problems by understanding the impact to the user and by assigning an appropriate priority and resolution goal. Clearly communicates technical solutions in a user-friendly, professional manner; provide one-on-one end-user training as needed. Performs Active Directory user account changes. Maintain Active Directory Computer environment. Proposes and implements hardware and software upgrades optimizing systems performance while remaining within budget. Helps install local area network cabling systems and equipment such as network interface cards, switches, and VPN devices with the network team. Manages and updates an accurate IT equipment inventory. Maintain spare parts inventory for IT software, hardware, and network printers. Creates Purchase Requisitions and handles equipment receipt as needed. Track software license compliance and perform annual audits to confirm licensing compliance. Manage signoffs and software change requests in accordance with IT procedures and Sarbanes Oxley requirements. Maintains a clean and organized environment. Assists Network Administrator as needed. Tracks and maintains server backups and tape rotation, working with Server Administrator. Perform related work as required. Employment Standards Work effectively in a Safety-minded industrial manufacturing environment. Ensure the security of all company systems and data. Understand business priorities, continuously reconsider the changing list of issues according to those priorities and communicate that list to management. Transition swiftly between those complex priorities in a fast-paced environment. Deliver effective technical customer support in person and over the phone. Support and train end-users in a wide range of software applications as needed. Read, understand and apply complex technical information. Master new computer technology and its local applicability. Maintain cooperative working relationships with internal and external customers, vendors and the team. Demonstrate sensitivity to, and respect for, a diverse population. Qualifications Required Skills & Abilities : Mathematical Skills Each candidate must have the ability to understand and apply basic algebraic and geometric principles within the field of IT. Reasoning Ability The individual must portray the ability to analytically solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations where standardization is not guaranteed. In addition, the candidate must be able to interpret different types of instructions ranging from written and oral instructions to diagrams and schedules. Special requirements The candidate must be able to sit for prolonged periods of time in front of a computer. Must be able to perform physical activities, such as, but not limited to, lifting heavy equipment (up to 50 lbs. unassisted), bending, standing, climbing or walking. The candidate must also portray a sincere desire to learn and broaden their knowledge base within IT thereby increasing their value to the company. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential tasks of this position. Required Education & Experience The candidate must have a minimum of 2 years college credit i.e. sophomore status at an accredited college or university in Computer Information Systems or related field of study. It is recommended that the candidate has completed one year end-user phone support for current PC desktop and application software OR one year installing, upgrading, troubleshooting and repairing personal computers in a network environment.

review_candidates.title: Senior Staff Engineer - VCF Lead Architect
review_candidates.description: Company Description We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (15000+ experts across 26 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in! Job Description We are looking for a VCF Lead Architect to lead enterprise VMware modernization engagements, moving large vSphere 8 environments to VMware Cloud Foundation 9.x. You will own the technical direction, define target architectures and migration roadmaps, and act as the lead technical advisor to client stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Assess multi-vCenter vSphere 8 environments, including Enhanced Linked Mode, Distributed Switch readiness and blockers to VCF adoption. Evaluate identity changes (Integrated Windows Authentication to LDAPS) and third-party backup compatibility with VCF. Produce compatibility baselines, risk registers and phased migration roadmaps. Define target-state ESXi boot and lifecycle architecture, including Auto Deploy, vSphere Lifecycle Manager images and UEFI HTTPS Boot. Guide client teams in designing and validating VCF lab environments (Holodeck), covering NSX, VCF Operations and lifecycle workflows. Lead client workshops, present findings to technical and leadership audiences, and review the work of other engineers on the team. Required Skills Hands-on VMware Cloud Foundation experience (VCF 5.x or later): SDDC Manager, management and workload domains, lifecycle management. Strong vSphere 8 architecture skills: vCenter, ESXi, ELM, DRS/HA, EVC and VDS. Working knowledge of NSX, VCF Operations (Aria Operations) and Active Directory over LDAPS. Proven experience writing assessment reports, architecture designs and migration roadmaps. Excellent communication skills in English for client-facing work. Good to Have Exposure to VCF 9.x or VMware Holodeck. Auto Deploy and stateless ESXi at scale. Experience with Rubrik or similar backup platforms. Experience in multi-vCenter consolidation projects. Qualifications Must have skills: ESXi & LDAP, VMware, vSphere 8

review_candidates.title: Analista de Infraestrutura - DBRE Sênior
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analista de Infraestrutura - DBRE Sênior (Senior Infrastructure Analyst – Database Reliability Engineering) based in Brazil. As a Senior Infrastructure Analyst specializing in Database Reliability Engineering (DBRE), you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure database environments. You will contribute to the reliability and continuous evolution of technology products by implementing infrastructure automation, observability, and database performance improvements. Working across cloud and private cloud environments, you will help ensure that critical data platforms can support growing customer bases and high transaction volumes. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, lead technical initiatives, and establish best practices for SQL and NoSQL database infrastructure. This role combines hands-on technical expertise, strategic thinking, and operational ownership in a collaborative, remote-first technology environment. It is an excellent opportunity to influence infrastructure architecture and strengthen the reliability of business-critical systems. Accountabilities Plan and technically lead infrastructure and database reliability projects in collaboration with engineering and technology teams. Design and implement infrastructure improvements focused on availability, scalability, performance, reliability, and security. Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and modern DevOps practices. Implement, maintain, and continuously improve database capacity and availability monitoring systems. Define, establish, and promote best practices for SQL and NoSQL database clusters, ensuring consistency, performance, and operational reliability. Plan database capacity and infrastructure growth to accommodate increasing customer demand, data volumes, and transaction loads. Design, build, and maintain highly scalable database environments capable of supporting large-scale production workloads. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents, identifying root causes and implementing preventive measures. Develop proactive monitoring systems and alerts based on service symptoms, performance indicators, and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Act as a technical reference for the team, sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues, and encouraging continuous improvement. Document technical processes, infrastructure configurations, and operational solutions to promote standardization, knowledge sharing, and automation. Manage database-related suppliers, service providers, and consulting contracts, ensuring the quality and effectiveness of external services. Collaborate with engineering teams to continuously improve infrastructure architecture, operational processes, and database reliability. Requirements Must be currently residing in Brazil and eligible for employment under Brazilian labor regulations (CLT). Proven experience working with cloud providers such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience managing private cloud environments, particularly VMware. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform, Ansible, and GitLab. Strong database administration experience across SQL technologies, particularly PostgreSQL and MySQL. Experience managing NoSQL databases such as DocumentDB, DynamoDB, and MongoDB. Solid knowledge of Linux operating systems, including Red Hat, Debian, and Ubuntu. Practical experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Zabbix. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Bash, Shell, or other relevant programming languages. Experience designing and maintaining reliable, scalable infrastructure capable of supporting high-volume production environments. Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills, with the ability to investigate complex infrastructure and database issues. Ability to establish technical standards, implement automation strategies, and improve infrastructure reliability. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to share technical knowledge and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Creative and proactive mindset, demonstrating curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine interest in learning and adopting new technologies. Ability to take ownership of technical challenges, work autonomously, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Benefits Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in Brazil, with a flexible working schedule. Flexible working arrangements: Remote work policies that support temporary relocation and greater work-life balance. Home office allowance: R$1,500 to support the setup and improvement of your home workspace. Monthly remote work allowance: R$250 per month, with the option to allocate R$50 toward a private pension plan. Meal and flexible benefits: R$988 through Alelo Tudo, available as meal vouchers, food allowances, or flexible benefits. Healthcare coverage: Medical and dental insurance with no copayment for employees, with the possibility of adding dependents. Life insurance: Additional financial protection for you and your family. Telemedicine: Access to remote medical consultations and specialized healthcare services. Wellness programs: Gympass membership, sports and nutrition coaching, and free telepsychology services for employees and their dependents. Birthday benefit: An additional day off to celebrate your birthday. Family support: Extended maternity and paternity leave, pregnancy support, and childcare assistance for children up to 71 months old. Coworking access: Partnership with Woba, providing access to coworking spaces throughout Brazil. Professional development: Access to a dedicated Learning Hub with resources and programs to support continuous learning and career development. Internal mobility: Opportunities to explore different roles and career paths within the organization. Performance incentives: Participation in the company's profit-sharing program. International collaboration: Opportunities to connect and exchange knowledge with colleagues across different countries. Collaborative culture: An inclusive and supportive environment that values diversity, transparency, open communication, autonomy, and continuous improvement. Career growth: Opportunities to contribute to innovative technology projects while developing your technical expertise and professional potential. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Engineer II, Systems Reliability Engineering
review_candidates.description: Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future Introduction As an Engineer II, Systems Reliability Engineering, you will help ensure the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of our Retail Technology platforms. You will work across applications, infrastructure, and store technologies to improve service stability, automate operations, and drive continuous improvement. Reporting to the Systems Reliability Engineering leadership team, you will partner with engineers, product teams, and technology stakeholders to deliver resilient and scalable technology solutions that support our global retail business. About The Job Drive reliability, availability, and performance improvements across retail technology platforms, applications, and infrastructure. Lead operational activities including incident response, problem management, change management, release readiness, and service transition processes. Develop and implement automation, observability, and monitoring solutions that improve operational efficiency and proactively identify service issues. Partner with product, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver stable, scalable, and customer-focused technology services. Analyze service health, capacity, performance, and reliability metrics to drive continuous improvement, operational resilience, and business continuity. About You 8+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), application support, infrastructure engineering, production operations, or a related technology discipline. Experience managing or supporting enterprise-scale applications and infrastructure in complex business environments. Hands-on experience with incident management, problem management, change management, and production support practices. Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as New Relic, application performance monitoring (APM) tools, or similar technologies. Experience using automation and scripting tools such as Python, PowerShell, CI/CD platforms, or cloud technologies to improve operational efficiency and reliability. Experience in Retail Platforms & Store Technology: Xstore, Xoffice, Point of Sale,ORCE, MPOS, RFID, Omnichannel, Retail Store Systems, Network, and Infrastructure. Experience in Enterprise Platforms (APIs, Middleware, Azure, Databases, Endpoints) Experience in Reliability Engineering (Major Incident, Problem, Change, SRE, Resilience) Experience in Observability & Automation (New Relic, Python, PowerShell, CI/CD, AIOps) Experience in Operational Governance (ITIL, Security, SOX, Risk, Vendor Management) Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require current or future employment visa sponsorship. The company does not participate in the H-1B cap lottery or sponsor initial employment visas. Candidates with an existing H-1B visa that is eligible for transfer may be considered. EOE M/F/Disability/Vets LOCATION Remote - USA FULL TIME/PART TIME Full time FILL DATE This position is expected to be filled by 01/17/2027. Current LS&Co Employees, apply via your Workday account.

review_candidates.description: Join Concentrix as an IT Support Specialist in Townsville, where your focus will be on supporting our on-site team, being hands-on and solving problems. We're looking for someone with a great attitude, strong work ethic and a genuine willingness to help, who takes pride in delivering reliable IT support and making a difference every day. Australian citizenship is essential, and the role is fully on-site. The End User Support team is a 100% on-site role who provides desk-side support to the local Concentrix site in Townsville, as well as remote assistance across ANZ with their information technology and telephony infrastructure. Physical Requirements: This is a hands-on, physically active role that requires regular movement. You will be installing and replacing IT equipment, lifting, and moving computer equipment, including printers, using the available trolleys. You will also be required to unpack, pack, and prepare hardware. The role requires bending, kneeling, crouching and reaching behind or underneath desks to install, troubleshoot and tidy equipment and cabling, as well as working within communications and server rooms. The role involves the setup, configuration and support of local site infrastructure including machine software and hardware, telephony (VoIP), printers and networks. Due to the nature of our clients and projects, candidates must be Australian Citizens to be considered for this role. Thank you for your understanding. What You’ll Be Doing: Desktop & User Support – Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows & Mac devices , manage accounts, and track IT assets. Network & Connectivity – Assist with LAN/WAN troubleshooting , patching, and basic network admin tasks. Telephony & VoIP – Support local VoIP infrastructure , diagnose issues, and coordinate handset replacements. Server & Security – Perform basic server troubleshooting , ensure patching and security compliance . Printers & IT Equipment – Provide first-level printer support , maintain video conferencing and smart board systems. Process & Compliance – Follow IT security guidelines , PCI/COPC standards, and contribute to documentation & knowledge sharing. Complete all assigned, mandatory training within the timeframe provided Conduct and/or participate in regularly scheduled 1:1 meetings with direct manager What You Bring: Minimum 3 years' experience in IT industry / last 2 years working in an IT company Strong skills in Windows & Mac support, troubleshooting, and hardware/software setup Understanding of networking (WAN/LAN), VoIP, and Active Directory Ability to diagnose & resolve IT issues independently both in person and remotely Experience working with O365, Microsoft Office, network printers, and enterprise applications Great communication skills and a customer-first mindset Bonus Points If You Have: Experience with local infrastructure, including Cisco networking and Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems Why Join Us? At Concentrix, you’ll be part of a collaborative, supportive IT team in a dynamic work environment. review_candidates.title: Network Deploy Technician , Global Network Delivery
review_candidates.description: Description AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network. The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers. You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures. All Physical Requirements Are Expected With Reasonable Accommodations Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered. NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States). #DCPD_GND Key job responsibilities Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects Collaboration with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles Troubleshoot networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low level application interaction Up to 20% travel within geographical work area is required. Some travel outside traditional work area may be requested, including internationally Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment Participate in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided. About The Team Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Basic Qualifications 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience 1+ years of computer networking experience High school or equivalent diploma Preferred Qualifications Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits. USA, OR, Boardman - 27.98 - 48.99 USD hourly Company - Amazon Data Services, Inc. Job ID: A10602698

review_candidates.title: Manager, Linux Platform
review_candidates.description: Permanent Position Eastern Suburb / Hybrid Work / 3 Days on Site Amazing Environment and Culture / Fantastic work life balance Our client is seeking an experienced Manager - Linux Platforms to lead the strategy, operations and continuous improvement of enterprise Linux and automation services within a large, complex education environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically credible leader to manage high-performing infrastructure teams, drive platform modernisation and deliver secure, resilient and scalable services supporting critical research, teaching and enterprise systems. About the Role Reporting to the Group Manager - Server, Cloud and Compute Platforms, you will lead the Linux Platforms and Linux Delivery teams, with direct responsibility for six staff. You will oversee the operational performance, security, lifecycle management and strategic direction of enterprise Linux environments across complex hybrid cloud infrastructure. The role combines people leadership, technical strategy, service delivery and operational governance, with a strong focus on infrastructure automation, modern platform engineering, observability and continuous improvement. While strong technical expertise is essential, this is primarily a leadership and management position rather than a hands-on engineering role. Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor and develop high-performing Linux engineering and delivery teams, fostering collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. Oversee enterprise Linux environments, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu, ensuring availability, performance, security and compliance. Drive infrastructure automation and configuration management using **Ansible, Puppet and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** practices. Champion modern **DevOps, platform engineering, intelligent monitoring, observability and AI-enabled operations (AIOps)** to improve reliability and operational efficiency. Develop and execute Linux platform strategies, technology roadmaps, lifecycle management and capacity planning initiatives. Manage operational budgets, vendor relationships, licensing, cost forecasting and infrastructure optimisation. Establish and maintain effective IT service management practices, including incident, problem, change and release management, on-call support and escalation processes. Lead platform uplift initiatives, including technology refreshes, version upgrades, infrastructure consolidation and automation improvements. Ensure robust cyber security, regulatory compliance, disaster recovery, backup validation and operational documentation standards. Collaborate with senior technology leaders, architects, cyber security teams and business stakeholders to align infrastructure services with organisational priorities. Skills and Experience Required Proven experience leading and managing enterprise infrastructure, Linux engineering or platform operations teams within large, complex ICT environments. Strong technical knowledge of enterprise Linux platforms, particularly Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Ubuntu. Extensive experience with automation and configuration management technologies, including Ansible, Puppet or equivalent. Demonstrated understanding of Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, CI/CD and modern platform engineering practices. Experience implementing monitoring, observability, operational automation and proactive incident management capabilities. Strong knowledge of IT service management, operational support models, incident management, disaster recovery and infrastructure resilience. Proven experience managing operational budgets, vendors, licensing and infrastructure costs. Experience delivering platform modernisation, technology uplift and large-scale infrastructure transformation initiatives. Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and senior leadership. Demonstrated ability to contribute to technology strategy, architecture decisions, risk management and long-term infrastructure planning. Relevant tertiary or postgraduate qualifications, extensive management experience, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. Highly Desirable: Exposure to AIOps, AI-enabled monitoring and intelligent automation. Experience managing Linux platforms across hybrid cloud environments. Familiarity with enterprise cyber security, governance and regulatory compliance frameworks. Experience supporting large-scale research, education or similarly complex enterprise technology environments. If you are an experienced Linux infrastructure leader with a passion for people management, automation and modern platform engineering, apply now! For any further information, please feel free to reach out to Peter (Peter.Li@talentinternational.com).

review_candidates.title: Senior Consultant – Identity and Security (Resident Engineer)
review_candidates.location: Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
review_candidates.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Consultant – Identity and Security to join our team in Malaysia as a Resident Engineer . The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, with a solid background in identity and access management. This role involves designing, implementing, and managing identity and security solutions for our clients, alongside day-to-day administration, operational support, and troubleshooting to maintain secure and reliable environments. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, administer, and maintain Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID solutions. Develop and maintain identity and access management policies, procedures, and best practices. Administer and support Microsoft Defender XDR solutions, including security policy configuration, alert investigation, incident response, and troubleshooting. Conduct security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and recommend appropriate remediation measures. Work closely with clients to understand their identity and security requirements and provide expert technical guidance. Troubleshoot and resolve complex identity and security issues, coordinating with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution. Lead and mentor junior consultants and technical staff. Stay current with developments in identity and access management and Microsoft security technologies. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, implementation plans, operational procedures, and technical reports. Requirements: Must be based in Malaysia. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. A minimum of 5 years of experience in identity and access management , with a focus on Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. In-depth knowledge of identity and authentication protocols, including LDAP, SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect. Experience with Microsoft 365 and cloud-based or hybrid identity environments. Hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender XDR stack , including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Cloud Apps. Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM) , including device enrollment, configuration profiles, device compliance policies, and app protection policies. Strong understanding of security principles, access controls, and industry best practices. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, stakeholders, and technical teams. Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate , are an advantage.
